export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let stored: StoredView | null = null;
  const mark = () => { stored = capture(camera, canvas); };
  mark();
  return {
    mark,
    shift(point) {
      const now = capture(camera, canvas);
      const a = stored!;
      const pa = projectPoint(point, a);
      const pb = projectPoint(point, now);
      return { dx: pb.cssX - pa.cssX, dy: pb.cssY - pa.cssY };
    }
  };
}
```

import {
  getCameraPosition,
  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,
  projectWorldToScreen,
  resolveCameraViewport,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
export interface ShiftTracker { mark(): void; shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number } }

type Mat = ReturnType<typeof getViewMatrix>;
type Viewport = ReturnType<typeof resolveCameraViewport>;
type ProjectPoint = Parameters<typeof projectWorldToScreen>[0];
type ProjectOptions = Parameters<typeof projectWorldToScreen>[3];

interface StoredView {
  view: Mat;
  viewProjection: Mat;
  viewport: Viewport;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
  worldOrigin: Vec | null;
}

function copyMat(m: Mat): Mat {
  // Mat4 is expected to be an array-like Float32Array.
  return (m as unknown as { slice(): Mat }).slice();
}

function copyViewport(v: Viewport): Viewport {
  return { x: v.x, y: v.y, width: v.width, height: v.height };
}

function cssSize(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, backingWidth: number, backingHeight: number): { width: number; height: number } {
  let width = canvas.clientWidth;
  let height = canvas.clientHeight;
  if (!Number.isFinite(width) || width <= 0) width = backingWidth;
  if (!Number.isFinite(height) || height <= 0) height = backingHeight;
  if (!Number.isFinite(width) || width <= 0) width = 1;
  if (!Number.isFinite(height) || height <= 0) height = 1;
  return { width, height };
}

function capture(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): StoredView {
  let backingWidth = canvas.width;
  let backingHeight = canvas.height;
  const css = cssSize(canvas, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  if (!Number.isFinite(backingWidth) || backingWidth <= 0) backingWidth = css.width;
  if (!Number.isFinite(backingHeight) || backingHeight <= 0) backingHeight = css.height;
  if (!Number.isFinite(backingWidth) || backingWidth <= 0) backingWidth = 1;
  if (!Number.isFinite(backingHeight) || backingHeight <= 0) backingHeight = 1;

  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const view = copyMat(getViewMatrix(camera));
  const viewProjection = copyMat(getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect));
  const viewport = copyViewport(resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight));
  const worldOrigin = camera._useFloatingOrigin ? (() => {
    const p = getCameraPosition(camera);
    return { x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z };
  })() : null;
  return { view, viewProjection, viewport, backingWidth, backingHeight, cssWidth: css.width, cssHeight: css.height, worldOrigin };
}

function projectFor(view: StoredView, point: Vec): { cssX: number; cssY: number } {
  const options: ProjectOptions = {
    viewport: view.viewport,
    backingWidth: view.backingWidth,
    backingHeight: view.backingHeight,
    cssWidth: view.cssWidth,
    cssHeight: view.cssHeight,
  };
  if (view.worldOrigin) {
    (options as { worldOrigin?: unknown }).worldOrigin = view.worldOrigin as unknown as ProjectOptions["worldOrigin"];
  }
  const r = projectWorldToScreen(point as unknown as ProjectPoint, view.view, view.viewProjection, options);
  return { cssX: r.cssX, cssY: r.cssY };
}

export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let stored: StoredView | null = null;
  const mark = (): void => {
    stored = capture(camera, canvas);
  };
  mark();

    mark,
    shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number } {
      const before = stored;
      if (!before) return { dx: 0, dy: 0 };

      const b = projectFor(capture(camera, canvas), point);
      return { dx: b.cssX - a.cssX, dy: b.cssY - a.cssY };
    },
  };
}

import type { Camera } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import {
  getCameraPosition,
  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,
  projectWorldToScreen,
  resolveCameraViewport,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface ShiftTracker {
  mark(): void;
  shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number };
}

type Mat = ReturnType<typeof getViewMatrix>;
type Viewport = ReturnType<typeof resolveCameraViewport>;
type ProjectedPoint = Parameters<typeof projectWorldToScreen>[0];
type ProjectOptions = Parameters<typeof projectWorldToScreen>[3];

interface StoredView {
  view: Mat;
  viewProjection: Mat;
  viewport: Viewport;
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
  worldOrigin: Vec | null;
}

function copyMat(matrix: Mat): Mat {
  const candidate = matrix as unknown as { clone?: () => Mat; slice?: () => Mat };
  if (typeof candidate.clone === "function") {
    return candidate.clone();
  }
  if (typeof candidate.slice === "function") {
    return candidate.slice();
  }
  return matrix;
}

function copyViewport(viewport: Viewport): Viewport {
  return { x: viewport.x, y: viewport.y, width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height };
}

function positive(value: number, fallback: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
}

function captureView(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): StoredView {
  const backingWidth = positive(canvas.width, positive(canvas.clientWidth, 1));
  const backingHeight = positive(canvas.height, positive(canvas.clientHeight, 1));
  const cssWidth = positive(canvas.clientWidth, backingWidth);
  const cssHeight = positive(canvas.clientHeight, backingHeight);

  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const view = copyMat(getViewMatrix(camera));
  const viewProjection = copyMat(getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect));
  const viewport = copyViewport(resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight));

  let worldOrigin: Vec | null = null;
  if (camera._useFloatingOrigin) {
    const position = getCameraPosition(camera);
    worldOrigin = { x: position.x, y: position.y, z: position.z };
  }

  return {
    view,
    viewProjection,
    viewport,
    backingWidth,
    backingHeight,
    cssWidth,
    cssHeight,
    worldOrigin,
  };
}

function projectCss(view: StoredView, point: Vec): { cssX: number; cssY: number } {
  const options: ProjectOptions = {
    viewport: view.viewport,
    backingWidth: view.backingWidth,
    backingHeight: view.backingHeight,
    cssWidth: view.cssWidth,
    cssHeight: view.cssHeight,
  };
  if (view.worldOrigin) {
    (options as Record<string, unknown>).worldOrigin = view.worldOrigin;
  }
  const projected = projectWorldToScreen(
    point as unknown as ProjectedPoint,
    view.view,
    view.viewProjection,
    options,
  );
  return { cssX: projected.cssX, cssY: projected.cssY };
}

export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let stored: StoredView | null = null;

  const mark = (): void => {
    stored = captureView(camera, canvas);
  };

  mark();

  return {
    mark,
    shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number } {
      const before = stored;
      if (!before) {
        return { dx: 0, dy: 0 };
      }
      const from = projectCss(before, point);
      const to = projectCss(captureView(camera, canvas), point);
      return { dx: to.cssX - from.cssX, dy: to.cssY - from.cssY };
    },
  };
}
```

function normalizeViewport(v: Viewport, w: number, h: number): Viewport {
  let width = Number.isFinite(v.width) ? v.width : w;
  let height = Number.isFinite(v.height) ? v.height : h;
  if (width <= 0) { width = w; v.x = 0; }
  if (height <= 0) { height = h; v.y = 0; }
  width = Math.min(width, w);
  height = Math.min(height, h);
  let x = Number.isFinite(v.x) ? v.x : 0;
  let y = Number.isFinite(v.y) ? v.y : 0;
  x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, w - width));
  y = Math.max(0, Math.min(y, h - height));
  return { x, y, width, height };
}
```

function normalizeViewport(viewport: Viewport, width: number, height: number): Viewport {
  let w = Number.isFinite(viewport.width) ? viewport.width : width;
  let h = Number.isFinite(viewport.height) ? viewport.height : height;
  if (w <= 0) { w = width; }
  if (h <= 0) { h = height; }
  w = Math.min(w, width);
  h = Math.min(h, height);
  let x = Number.isFinite(viewport.x) ? viewport.x : 0;
  let y = Number.isFinite(viewport.y) ? viewport.y : 0;
  x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, width - w));
  y = Math.max(0, Math.min(y, height - h));
  return { x, y, width: w, height: h };
}
```

    const trimmed = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (trimmed.endsWith("px")) {
      const n = Number(trimmed.slice(0, -2));
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) return n;

  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : fallback;

function copyMat(matrix: Mat): Mat {
  const candidate = matrix as unknown as {
    clone?: () => Mat;
    slice?: () => Mat;
    length?: number;
    [index: number]: number;
  };
  if (typeof candidate.clone === "function") {
    return candidate.clone();

  if (typeof candidate.slice === "function") {

  if (typeof candidate.length === "number" && candidate.length > 0 && typeof candidate[0] === "number") {

  h = Math.min(h, height);

export function trackScreenShift(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): ShiftTracker {
  let stored: StoredView | null = null;

  const mark = (): void => {
    stored = captureView(camera, canvas);
  };

  mark();

  return {
    mark,
    shift(point: Vec): { dx: number; dy: number } {
      const before = stored;
      if (!before) {
        return { dx: 0, dy: 0 };
      }
      const from = projectCss(before, point);
      const to = projectCss(captureView(camera, canvas), point);
      return { dx: to.cssX - from.cssX, dy: to.cssY - from.cssY };
    },
  };
}

function resolveSizes(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): { backingWidth: number; backingHeight: number; cssWidth: number; cssHeight: number } {
  const rawBackingWidth = positive(canvas.width, 0);
  const rawBackingHeight = positive(canvas.height, 0);
  const rawCssWidth = positive(canvas.clientWidth, 0);
  const rawCssHeight = positive(canvas.clientHeight, 0);
  const backingWidth = rawBackingWidth > 0 ? rawBackingWidth : (rawCssWidth > 0 ? rawCssWidth : 1);
  const backingHeight = rawBackingHeight > 0 ? rawBackingHeight : (rawCssHeight > 0 ? rawCssHeight : 1);
  const cssWidth = rawCssWidth > 0 ? rawCssWidth : backingWidth;
  const cssHeight = rawCssHeight > 0 ? rawCssHeight : backingHeight;
  return { backingWidth, backingHeight, cssWidth, cssHeight };
}
